description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Greenfield Engineering, a Saalex Company, is hiring a Junior Software Developer to support mission-critical DoD programs. The role designs, develops, tests, and maintains software solutions, contributes to secure and scalable applications, and collaborates with teams on requirements, enhancements, testing, and deployment.
Junior Software Developer building, testing, and maintaining C/C++ applications and resolving defects to improve system reliability

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications using modern programming practices
• Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code in C/C++ and other object-oriented languages
• Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects to ensure system reliability and performance
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and implement technical solutions
• Support system enhancements by adding new features and optimizing existing functionality
• Contribute to software testing efforts, including unit testing and integration testing
• Assist with version control, build pipelines, and deployment activities
• Other duties as assigned or required

Requirements:
• Experience developing in C, C++, C#, and/or Java
• Experience working in object orientation
• Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC)
• Experience with debugging, testing, and maintaining applications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Engineering discipline (must be a completed, accredited degree) required
• 1-3 years of relevant professional or internship experience in software development
• Secret clearance required with the ability to obtain a Top Secret Yankee White clearance required
• US Citizenship

Preferred:
• Experience with Ada95/98
• Experience with real-time operating systems
• Familiarity with Mission Systems Avionics
• Knowledge of military narrowband communications
